column1: # Every path the edge's units name, and what creates it before the unit runs.
# One row per path: <path> <created_by> <reason>, tab-separated.
# Each of the four defects the console found on the from-scratch install was one
# shape: a unit named a path the retired hand bootstrap had made on the old VPS,
# and nothing in the image made it. `scripts/check-edge-unit-paths.sh` holds this
# table to the units and each claim to the tree, so a row that is missing, unused
# or wrong fails a pull request instead of a boot.
# created_by is one of:
#   image-dir  a directory in bootc/edge/rootfs/ itself
#   tmpfiles   a fragment under etc/tmpfiles.d or usr/lib/tmpfiles.d creates it
#   bootstrap  scripts/edge-bootstrap.sh creates it (the reason names the function);
#              no row uses it today: every state directory the units write comes
#              from tmpfiles, because a unit cannot wait for a hand step
#   operator   the operator makes it before the box is useful (the reason names
#              the step in docs/manual-steps.md)
#   system     the OS owns it, so nothing has to create it
# A unit may prefix a path with `-`, systemd's ignore-if-missing marker. The
# checker strips it and the row's reason says the path is optional.
/boot
column3: the boot partition is mounted before any unit runs; `bootc switch` writes the boot entry there

column1: /etc/caddy/edge.env
column3: the ACME address and the two Service upstreams the Caddyfile substitutes, written on the box at docs/manual-steps.md#bootstrap-the-fresh-edge

column1: /etc/smoresnet/tailscale-authkey
column3: the preauthorized tag:vps key the join unit reads as a credential, entered on stdin at docs/manual-steps.md#bootstrap-the-fresh-edge

column1: /sysroot
column3: the ostree root is always mounted; `bootc rollback --apply` remounts it writable

column1: /tmp
column3: tmpfs the OS mounts; bootc's SELinux install_t probe writes a scratch file there

column1: /var/lib/caddy
column3: Caddy's ACME account key and certificates live here and nothing else creates it, so every order would fail `mkdir /var/lib/caddy: permission denied`

column1: /var/lib/homelab/deploy
column3: the deploy state tree the listener, poll, heartbeat, gate and drain all write; a ReadWritePaths target's namespace setup fails with 226/NAMESPACE when it is absent

column1: /var/lib/homelab/deploy/queue
column3: the queue smoresnet-deploy.path watches with DirectoryNotEmpty= to start the drain; 226/NAMESPACE when absent

column1: /var/lib/smoresnet
column3: the boot gate's ReadWritePaths target and the tailnet node identity, 0700; its namespace setup fails with 226/NAMESPACE when it is absent on the boot after an install

column1: /var/tmp
column3: the OS owns it; bootc stages under it and PrivateTmp= confines the unit's copy
